Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning solid waste and recyclable materials collection ordinances.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to solid waste and recyclable materials collectionordinances; amending RCW 35.21.130; and adding a new section to chapter35A.21 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 35.21.130 and 1989 c 431 s 51 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Except as otherwise provided in this section, a solid waste orrecyclable materials collection ordinance may: (((1))) (a) Require property owners and occupants of premises touse the solid waste collection and disposal system or recyclablematerials collection and disposal system, and to dispose of their solidwaste and recyclable materials as provided in the ordinance: PROVIDED,That a solid waste or recycling ordinance shall not require any retailenterprise engaged in the sale of consumerpackaged products to locateor place a public recycling collection site or buyback center upon orwithin a certain distance of the retail establishment as a condition ofengaging in the sale of consumerpackaged products; and (((2))) (b) Fix charges for solid waste collection and disposal,recyclable materials collection and disposal, or both, and the manner p. 1 HB 3126and time of payment therefor including therein a provision that uponfailure to pay the charges, the amount thereof shall become a lienagainst the property for which the solid waste or recyclable materialscollection service is rendered. The ordinance may also providepenalties for its violation. (2) A solid waste or recyclable materials collection ordinanceadopted under subsection (1) of this section may not require theoccupants of a mobile or manufactured home park to: (a) Use the solid waste collection and disposal system orrecyclable materials collection and disposal system as provided in theordinance; or (b) Dispose of their solid waste and recyclable materials asprovided in the ordinance. (3) A solid waste or recyclable materials collection ordinanceadopted under subsection (1) of this section must provide the owner ormanager of a mobile or manufactured home park the option, withoutfinancial penalty to the occupants, of subjecting the park to orexempting the park from the ordinance.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 35A.21 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) A solid waste or recyclable materials collection ordinance maynot require the occupants of a mobile or manufactured home park to: (a) Use the solid waste collection and disposal system orrecyclable materials collection and disposal system as provided in theordinance; or (b) Dispose of their solid waste and recyclable materials asprovided in the ordinance. (2) A solid waste or recyclable materials collection ordinance mustprovide the owner or manager of a mobile or manufactured home park theoption, without financial penalty to the occupants, of subjecting thepark to or exempting the park from the ordinance.
